info.title: TiDB Agent Workspace · Local Prototype API
info.description: A loopback Workspace gateway with opt-in real db9 PostgreSQL and TiDB Cloud Zero MySQL and Singapore Drive9 files. Existing local resources remain demos. Workspace Keys authorize actions and resources; upstream credentials stay internal. Zero trials expire; cloud usage is unmeasured. Production identity and public hosting are deferred.

get.summary: Read a fixed bounded CSV/Parquet schema and sample
get.description: Required workspace key scope: files:read. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint. Fixed CSV/Parquet schema/sample only: accepts resourceId/path, no custom SQL or engine settings. Requires files:read, not files:analyze. Whole version-verified snapshot up to 16 MiB, 15 seconds and shared two-worker budget; at most 20 rows, 50 columns, 128 KiB. CSV types are inferred and totalRows unknown; Parquet count is metadata. No automatic retry. Download unsupported or over-budget files.

totalRows.description: Exact Parquet metadata row count; null for CSV. Not the sample count.

post.summary: Run bounded read-only DuckDB SQL or Just Bash on one selected file
post.description: Required workspace key scope: files:analyze. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint. Also requires files:read. Discover engines from capabilities: CSV supports DuckDB SQL over table file or Just Bash over its raw UTF-8 text. Bash exposes the selected absolute Workspace path; discover input.path, input.workingDirectory and compatibility aliases on its engine option. Paths refer only to the virtual selected-file snapshot. Parquet supports only DuckDB, and other recognized text only Just Bash. Only the selected snapshot is available; no provider credentials, network, persistent writes or host paths. Limits: 16 MiB input, 64 KiB script, 15 seconds, 1000 rows / 1 MiB output, two active analyses. Large/unsupported files remain downloadable. No implicit retry.

post.summary: Parse an original file or Bash stream for explicit schema review
post.description: Required workspace key scope: files:analyze. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint. Also requires files:read and the source File System grant. Fixed CSV/Parquet/text-line parsing, no scripts. Up to 16 MiB original or 1 MiB output text, 1000 rows/100 columns/1 MiB parsed data and 15 seconds, shared worker admission. Returns 20 sample rows and suggested field types with an actor-bound five-minute preparation. Parsing writes nothing. CSV keeps leading zeros and distinguishes quoted empty strings from NULL. Text lines are explicit one-column records.

post.summary: Copy original bytes, export Bash text or commit a confirmed database import
post.description: Required workspace key scope: files:read. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint. Original copies require read access; Bash output requires read plus analyze. File targets require files:write and a target grant. Database commits require the exact actor preparation, confirmed=true, reviewed fields, source read/analyze and target queries:execute/grant. Original versions must match; single-use writes, no append/overwrite/retry. Output text is client-supplied authorization context, not attested command lineage. Only these two routes permit an 8 MiB JSON envelope for at most 1 MiB output text. Original downloads retain /files/content (local files use /files).

post.summary: Export a supplied result snapshot without rerunning its source query
post.description: Required workspace key scope: Source database: queries:execute; source File System: files:read and files:analyze. Destination additionally requires files:write or queries:execute and its resource grant. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. The local owner session may also call this endpoint. Client-supplied snapshot, not attested provenance. Up to 100 columns, 1000 rows, 16 nesting levels and 1 MiB request. Downloads: CSV/JSON/JSON Lines, up to 4 MiB encoded output. Files: conditional create, 256 KiB local / 1 MiB live plus provider limits. Database targets: active live resources, CREATE then one INSERT, each up to 64 KiB and 15 seconds; no transaction across both statements. Name collisions never append/replace. EXPORT_INCOMPLETE or a timeout may leave a new table; inspect before retrying. No automatic retry. Precision strings remain text; CSV renders null as empty and prefixes spreadsheet-formula strings. No result values are audited.

sources.description: DuckDB only: query-scoped CSV/JSON/NDJSON/Parquet snapshots as files.NAME. Nonempty sources require files:read, files:analyze and every source File System grant in addition to database query access. SELECT only; 16 MiB combined input and a shared 15-second deadline. Sources are not persisted.

name.description: Unique source table name in the per-query files catalog.

path.description: Exact absolute Workspace file path; no globs, traversal, external URLs or native paths.

sql.description: Live Zero/DuckDB: one statement up to 64 KiB, a 15-second deadline, at most 1000 result rows / 1 MiB. queries:execute allows reads and writes under the internal database role. No persistent session or automatic retry. A timeout or result limit can leave writes committed; check before retrying. Demo resources accept only SELECT 1 [AS connected] or SELECT * FROM agent_events [LIMIT n].
